# The Mindmaker

> Workshop, cohort-based, and enterprise advisory helping leaders make and ship nervous AI decisions. Founded by Krish Raja.

## Core offers

- [Workshops](/workshops): $599 per workshop, one day each, hosted on Maven. Five workshops (Build Your AI Chief of Staff, Map Your Agentic Org Chart, Vibe Coding for Leaders, Build an Autonomous Business Function, Give Your AI Memory). You build a real artefact alongside Krish on your real surface. Top-of-funnel paid product.
- [The AI-Fluent Executive (Cohort)](/cohort): $2,500 per seat, 4 weeks, quarterly. For senior leaders with a nervous AI decision to make. 10 to 15 seats per cohort, mostly async with weekly 90-minute live sessions. Diagnose, decompose, decide, deploy. Hosted on Maven at https://maven.com/mindmaker/the-ai-fluent-executive.
- [Enterprise](/enterprise): The Signal Session ($15,000, 1 day + 48h delivery). The Revenue Architecture ($60,000-$100,000, 30 days). For companies commercializing AI products. Public pricing is shown as ranges; the exact number is set by Krish on the call.
- [Capital](/capital): The same Signal Session and Revenue Architecture engagement formats, repositioned for funds, family offices, and operating partners. A third door alongside Enterprise.

## Request-only offers

- [The AI Immersion](/immersion): $12,000 flat. Half-day facilitated session for up to 8 senior leaders. Request-only, not featured in primary navigation. For CEO-level sponsors who need their exec team aligned on AI fast. 2-page board-ready summary within 5 business days.
- The Alumni Pass: $1,500/year recurring, invitation-only. Annual continuity programme for Mindmaker alumni: re-attendance of any workshop, quarterly state-of-the-market memo, alumni Slack, first-refusal cohort seats, lifetime CTRL access. Not in nav or footer; accessible by direct URL only post-engagement.

## How I operate

- [The operating system behind Mindmaker](/operator): 14-agent fleet managing a 13-venture portfolio, memory architecture, cost optimization patterns. The operational foundation the commercial advice is built on.

## Try it

- [The Diagnosis Room](/start): An on-site guided experience. Mindy works through one nervous AI decision with you and ends in one of three honest exits: keep chatting, book a free 15-minute call, or download a co-branded one-page proposal. Every "Book a call" CTA opens it. Free, no email required.
- [Mindmaker LIVE](/signal): Live model prices, weekly classified reads (WATCH / SKIP / CALL / TAKE), and the Nervous Decision Machine embedded in-page. Free, no email required.
- [Case studies](/case-studies): Anonymised client outcomes (cohort-style and enterprise), filterable.
- 5 free Lightning Lessons hosted on Maven (https://maven.com/mindmaker): 45-minute sessions. Top-of-funnel free product.

## Thought leadership

- [New Age Leadership](/new-age-leadership): How org charts change when AI agents become teammates. Interactive demonstration of human / hybrid / agent-first / emergent roles, with the role-design decisions leaders will face. Draws on the 14-agent Mindmaker fleet as a live example.

## Positioning

Mindmaker is a ladder, not a single product. Free Lightning Lessons sit at the top. Workshops at $599 are the entry paid product on Maven. The AI-Fluent Executive cohort at $2,500 is the qualifying step. Enterprise sprints from $15,000 to $100,000 are the margin engine. The Alumni Pass at $1,500/year is continuity. No 1:1 sprint product on the public site (inquiry only). No fractional executive roles. No ongoing retainers. No production IT work. Every engagement has a fixed scope and a finish line. Maven is the marketplace Mindmaker lists on; themindmaker.ai is the brand and operating centre.
